resources.string: Exam: tick the targets you reached
Every target reached. The next block starts with your next class.
Not yet: %1$s.\n\nRepeat the %2$d classes from %3$s and retake the exam? Your days, history and skills stay. Or move on to the next block.
Exam saved: not every target yet. Those are tested again at the next exam.
Repeating a block before its exam
You stopped at %1$s. Today takes you through the block and its exam again, then back there. Your days and history stay.

A real test: one fresh set of every skill family you train, at the number shown. Make it your first class of the day, then tick the targets you hit. Miss the headline skill, or three or more, and you can repeat the block first.
